newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria closes NNPC office in London.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria closes NNPC office in London.

text.p: Nigeria on Tuesday ordered the immediate closure of the London office of state oil company, the Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC).
An official statement in Lagos said the order for the closure was given by oil minister Dan Etete.
"This is in view of the current financial posture of the corporation," the statement added.
It said a smaller, coordinating office would soon be established somewhere else in Europe.
"All operating accounts and all other activities of the corporation in Britain are also to be closed accordingly," the statement said.
The NNPC London office, which is headed by a general manager, oversees Nigeria's oil transactions in Europe.
"NNPC assets in that country (Britain) shall be determined while the present staff in the London office are to return to Nigeria," the statement said.
